name: Teardown Voxel Rendering Pipeline
aliases: Voxel Ray Marching with Bounding Box Rasterization
definition: A custom voxel rendering engine that avoids a single massive axis-aligned volume, instead organizing scene geometry into thousands of smaller, internally axis-aligned voxel volumes to enable real-time environmental destruction and volumetric rendering.
summary: The Teardown Voxel Rendering Pipeline is a custom architecture that enables real-time destruction by organizing geometry into thousands of smaller voxel volumes, avoiding single massive grids and traditional meshes.
